description: The falling factorial (n)_k = n*(n-1)*...*(n-k+1). (5)_3 is 60, (5)_0 is 1, and (5)_6 is 0. n runs from 0 to 100000 and k runs from 0 to 512. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/falling
